title: MSI Afterburner Doesn't See GPU
fullDescription: Afterburner needs latest beta for new GPUs and admin rights. Disable other OC tools.

fixSteps.title: Install latest beta
fixSteps.instruction: Download newest Afterburner beta from MSI forums.

faq.a: Afterburner had a hiatus; community forks active.

title: Tri Frozr Fan Stops in Heavy Load
shortDescription: One of three fans stops mid-game.
fullDescription: Zero RPM mode is normal at low temp; mid-load stop indicates fan failure.

fixSteps.title: Replacement fan
fixSteps.instruction: Order TORX fan separately, install on shroud.

fixSteps.title: Cap FPS
fixSteps.instruction: NVCP > Manage 3D Settings > Max Frame Rate.

title: Suprim X No Display with 12VHPWR
shortDescription: Card detects no power and stays off.
fullDescription: 12V-2x6 connector must seat fully; sense pins prevent boot when partial.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Push until click; verify all 4 sense pins.

title: Mystic Light Doesn't List GPU
fullDescription: MSI Center service must run; reinstall via Microsoft Store.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall MSI Center
fixSteps.instruction: Microsoft Store > MSI Center > Reset / reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Mystic Light feature
fixSteps.instruction: MSI Center > Features > Install Mystic Light.

title: Suprim Liquid Pump Whine
fullDescription: Air bubble in loop. Tilt PC to bleed.

title: BSOD nvlddmkm.sys
fullDescription: Driver corruption or hardware. DDU + latest driver.

fixSteps.title: DDU clean install
fixSteps.instruction: Safe Mode > DDU > install latest Nvidia.

faq.a: Often more stable than Game Ready.

title: Suprim VRM 100C+
fullDescription: Improve case airflow; replace pads if past warranty.

title: MSI Center Fan Curve Reverts
fullDescription: Use Afterburner with Apply at startup option, or switch to MSI Center User Scenario.

causes.cause: MSI Center scenario stuck on Default

fixSteps.title: Set User Scenario
fixSteps.instruction: MSI Center > User Scenario > Customize fan curve.

faq.a: Afterburner with autostart is most reliable.
